text: The purpose of this staff report is to advise on the feasibility of installing a 40 km/h speed limit on Kingston Road, between Victoria Park Avenue and Birchmount Road and 50 km/h speed limit on Kingston Road, between Birchmount Road and Midland Avenue.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council reduce the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Kingston Road, between Victoria Park Avenue and Birchmount Road. 2. City Council reduce the speed limit from 60 km/h to 50 km/h on Kingston Road, between Birchmount Road and Midland Avenue.
